record.question: The increase in enrollment of Course A from 2019 to 2023 is what percentage of its enrollment in 2019?
record.explanation: Course A rises from 120 in 2019 to 180 in 2023. The increase is 60. As a percentage of the 2019 enrollment, 60÷120×100=50%, option C. Verified worked solution; unofficial. No matching official answer key was found in the targeted source search on 24 October 2026.
record.direction: Direction (Questions 70–72): The table below shows the number of students enrolled in three courses (A, B, and C) in a coaching institute over five years.
record.passage:
Year | Course A | Course B | Course C
2019 | 120 | 150 | 100
2020 | 140 | 160 | 110
2021 | 130 | 170 | 120
2022 | 160 | 180 | 140
2023 | 180 | 200 | 160

A line graph represents the total number of students enrolled each year.
